subsection: Secundum secretam doctrinam sapientum Hebraeorum Cabalistarum
latin_incipit: Rectius dicitur quod paradisus sit totum aedificium quam quod sit
latin_full: Rectius dicitur quod paradisus sit totum aedificium quam quod sit
english_translation:
It is more correctly said that paradise is the whole edifice than that it is

the tenth; and in its middle is set the great Adam, who is Tiferet.
english_full:
It is more correctly said that paradise is the whole edifice than that it is

the tenth; and in its middle is set the great Adam, who is Tiferet.
